crossRefs.note: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and…
So he made two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, and…
He carved cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.

translations.web: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.
translations.bsb: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
translations.kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
translations.asv: And now all the carved work thereof They break down with hatchet and hammers.
